cefrAlignment: Matches the B1 descriptors for announcements and instructions (understanding simple technical information and detailed directions, and following announcements on familiar topics): the monologues are 79–134 words in clear standard speech with a predictable structure.
examFidelity: TOEIC Part 4-style purpose, detail and action questions and IELTS Part 2-style note completion are accurate. The TOEFL tip now matches exams.ts (40–85 word classroom or campus announcements). The practice campus announcement (122 words) is longer than a real TOEFL announcement, which is acceptable for B1 practice.
fixes: ex2 audio: 'an hour and a half' became 'one and a half hours', so the notes gap 'about ___ hours' can be answered with what is heard instead of a conversion; added '1 ½' to the key

TOEFL tip in Learn: rewritten to match exams.ts (Listen to an Announcement, about 40–85 words, classroom or campus setting, schedules, rules and events) instead of unverified claims about question focus
TOEFL exam tip: removed the unsupported claim that two questions 'cover most of what you will be asked'
Spelling consistency: 'Student Center' changed to 'Student Centre' to match the lesson's UK spelling (apologise, programme)
openConcerns: Practice audio 4 uses US vocabulary (elevators, parking lot) with a US voice, while the rest of the lesson is British. This is intentional dialect exposure, but a specialist may want a note for learners.
'eleven a.m.' depends on the TTS sentence chunker not splitting at 'a.'. It works at the current length, but it is fragile if the text is edited.
learnerOutcome: A learner who does this lesson well can pick out the purpose, the changed time or place, and the required action in a public or workplace announcement, and follow multi-step instructions even when 'before' or 'once' reverses the order.
